CustomField.description: Saves the in-progress submission when the respondent moves forward off this page, the same as clicking Save Progress. Use it on pages whose answers should not be lost if the respondent leaves. Needs Allow Save Progress on the Form Template. In Stages Mode returning to the overview already saves, so this matters mainly for page-by-page forms.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check this to silently save the respondent's progress whenever they move forward from this page, so nothing is lost if they leave mid-form. The parent Form Template must have Allow Save Progress enabled for the save to run; in linear mode the respondent will not see a Save button being clicked.
CustomField.label: Auto Save
